items.text: Sean Payton will take a bigger hand in calling Denver's plays @LAC, with offensive coordinator Davis Webb keeping a large game-planning and game-day role, after four games that left the Broncos 27th in points. The plays change, not the players: Bo Nix (DEN) is QB13 for me, a borderline start this week, and Jaylen Waddle stays WR17, a WR2.

Philadelphia traded Cam Jurgens to Baltimore Wednesday for a 2028 second and a 2027 fifth, a day after Lane Johnson retired. Jurgens had played left guard since Landon Dickerson went on IR after Week 1, so Jalen Hurts (PHI) goes to London vs JAX with three new starters up front. Hurts is QB15 for me this week, a streamer, and QB9 rest of season. Hold him.
items.why: Two bad weeks behind the rebuilt line would change the call; one trade of a struggling guard does not.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (BAL) missed Wednesday's practice with the left ankle, and Jesse Minter says his status for Sunday night @ATL will be judged through the week. Tyler Huntley starts if he sits. Jackson is QB2 rest of season for me; hold him. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Zay Flowers (BAL) missed Wednesday's practice with a hamstring, on top of Jackson's ankle. He caught 8 of 10 for 118 and a TD vs TEN and is WR9 for me this week @ATL. Monitor; Thursday's practice report.

Jayden Daniels (WAS) practiced in full Wednesday on the left elbow, and Dan Quinn says a full practice by Friday puts him back vs NYG. Marcus Mariota's MCL sprain stays off IR. Daniels is QB11 for me, a borderline start this week.

Stefon Diggs (WAS) and Terry McLaurin (WAS, hamstring) both missed Wednesday's practice. Diggs led Washington's receivers in London with McLaurin out and is WR23 for me this week, a WR2, if he plays. Monitor Diggs; Thursday's practice report.

Kyle Monangai (CHI) missed Wednesday's practice with thumb and toe injuries after 30 carries for 146 and 2 TD vs NYJ; Ben Johnson says the thumb is not an issue. RB18 for me this week, an RB2. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

D'Andre Swift (CHI) also missed Wednesday's practice, with hip and knee injuries, so both Chicago backs sat with GB next. Swift is RB13 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 this week. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Alvin Kamara (NO) did not practice Wednesday with the back he hurt Monday vs ATL, with Travis Etienne already out. Kendre Miller is next and is RB40 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Kamara is a high-end RB3 for me this week. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Chris Olave (NO) sat out Wednesday's walkthrough, which the Saints called a rest day after the late hit Monday. Tyler Shough was limited with the left hand and says he will play vs MIN. Olave is WR7 for me this week.
Tyler Shough (NO) was limited Wednesday with his left hand wrapped and says he will play vs MIN. QB12 for me, a borderline start this week.

Justin Jefferson (MIN) was limited Wednesday in his first practice since the Week 3 ankle sprain. Jordan Addison sat with what Minnesota calls minor soreness. Jefferson is WR6 rest of season for me; hold him. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Malik Nabers (NYG) missed Wednesday's practice with a sore knee after catching 6 of 7 for 112 and a TD vs ARI. Cam Skattebo was limited with the shoulder and is RB19 for me, an RB2. Nabers is WR10 for me this week @WAS. Monitor Nabers; Thursday's practice report.

Tee Higgins (CIN) did not practice Wednesday, and the official report added a neck injury to the groin. Ja'Marr Chase stayed in the concussion protocol and did not practice either. Mike Gesicki is TE11 for me, a borderline start this week @MIA. Monitor Higgins; Friday's injury report.
Ashton Jeanty (LV) practiced in full Wednesday on the ankle that cut into his snaps vs KC. RB11 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 this week @NE. Brock Bowers was limited with the knee and is TE2 for me.

Mack Hollins (NE) missed Wednesday's practice with the calf again, and Drake Maye practiced in full. Romeo Doubs scored twice at BUF with Hollins hurt and is a high-end WR3 for me this week, a high-end flex play vs LV.
Breece Hall (NYJ) missed Wednesday's practice with the quad. Braelon Allen took all 14 back carries without him @CHI and is RB20 for me this week, an RB2.

Tank Dell (HOU) returned to practice Wednesday after missing all of 2025, which opens Houston's 21-day window to activate him. He has no snaps yet behind Nico Collins. Stash him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.

Baker Mayfield (TB) is targeting a Week 6 return vs PIT from the dislocated right thumb, a week earlier than the Week 7 Todd Bowles first floated, though the outside range is three to six weeks depending on his grip. Jalon Daniels starts Thursday @DAL, so Emeka Egbuka is WR41 and Chris Godwin WR47 for me this week, low-end flex plays to dart throws. Mayfield is QB24 rest of season for me. Monitor his practice reps the week of Week 6.
items.watch: his practice reps the week of Week 6

items.text: Zac Taylor calls Tee Higgins (CIN) day to day with the adductor, not a set two to three weeks, and Cincinnati has its bye in Week 6. Chase Brown and Dohnte Meyers keep the Week 5 bump @MIA either way. Higgins is WR16 rest of season for me. Monitor his practice Wednesday to Friday.

Rico Dowdle (PIT) is on track to return from the toe vs IND, and the coach calls the backfield a one-two punch. Jaylen Warren played 69 of 71 snaps @CLE with Dowdle out; he is RB8 for me this week and slides if Dowdle practices in full. Dowdle is RB34 rest of season for me. Monitor his practice participation Wednesday to Friday.

Breece Hall (NYJ) is week to week with the quad. Braelon Allen took all 14 back carries @CHI without him and is RB20 for me this week, an RB2, with Isaiah Davis in a small share. Hall is RB16 rest of season for me. Monitor Friday's injury report.

Ollie Gordon II (MIA) out-snapped and out-touched Jaylen Wright @MIN, with 9 carries for 100 and a TD to Wright's 5 for 7, so the snaps beat the depth chart. Gordon is RB30 for me this week, a high-end RB3, a high-end flex play. Wright is outside my top 40 backs; sit him.

Bhayshul Tuten (JAX) out-snapped Chris Rodriguez Jr. 36 to 15 @CIN and had two touchdowns called back on holding. He is RB15 for me this week vs PHI in London, an RB2, and RB18 rest of season. Trade for him; offer a WR3 or a bench RB with a smaller role.
items.price: a WR3 or a bench RB with a smaller role

items.text: Minnesota signed Odell Beckham Jr. to the practice squad Wednesday with Justin Jefferson (MIN) still working back from the ankle sprain that kept him out vs MIA. Beckham played 19 snaps for the Giants this year without a catch, so pass on him in every format. Jefferson stays off my Week 5 receivers @NO until he practices, and he is WR6 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's practice report.

Lane Johnson (PHI) retired Tuesday, four games into his 14th season, two days after he was inactive for personal reasons vs LAR. Philadelphia goes to London vs JAX without its right tackle, Saquon Barkley, Tank Bigsby, DeVonta Smith and Dallas Goedert. Jalen Hurts is QB9 rest of season for me. Hold him.
items.why: Two bad weeks behind the rebuilt line would change the call; one game in London will not.

items.text: Seattle passed on Joe Mixon after his physical Tuesday and will sign Robert Henry Jr. instead. Mixon stays a free agent after missing all of 2025 with the foot. Emanuel Wilson leads vs SF and Zach Charbonnet is the stash behind him. Drop Mixon.

Tyquan Thornton (KC) tore ligaments along with the dislocated left ankle and needs surgery that will cost him 12 to 16 weeks, with a postseason return possible. He caught 5 for 111 and 2 TDs in the game he got hurt. Drop him unless you have an open IR spot.

Mike Macdonald said Zach Charbonnet (knee) will not play vs SF, so Emanuel Wilson (SEA) has the whole Seattle backfield again after 21 carries and 2 TDs vs LAC. Charbonnet stays a stash until Week 6 at the earliest. Claim Wilson, 10 to 15 percent of FAAB.

Dan Quinn said Washington plans to have Jayden Daniels back as the starter (WAS) vs NYG after a full week of practice on the left elbow. Athan Kaliakmanis went 15 of 33 in London, so drop Kaliakmanis in superflex. Daniels is QB17 rest of season for me. Monitor Friday's injury report.

Puka Nacua (LAR) caught 9 for 125 @PHI in his first game back, and a sideline report says he has a pre-hernia that could worsen into one that needs surgery; he said he felt fine. WR5 rest of season for me. Trade for him, and offer a WR2 alone.

Ashton Jeanty (LV) ran 15 times for 58 and caught 6 of 8 for 68 vs KC, but the ankle cut into his snaps and the Las Vegas beat calls it a concern for Week 5. RB8 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's injury report.

Chris Olave (NO) limped off after a late hit in the fourth quarter of Monday's 45-24 loss to ATL, and Tuesday reports say he avoided a major injury. WR7 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's practice report.
Tyler Shough (NO) hurt his left hand in Monday's loss to ATL, and no severity was reported Tuesday. QB12 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's practice report.

Tyler Higbee (LAR) caught 5 for 67 @PHI and led the Rams tight ends in snaps for a second straight game with the two tight ends ahead of him hurt. TE38 rest of season for me. In TE-premium and deep leagues, add him, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.

Saquon Barkley (PHI) is week to week with the hamstring he hurt vs LAR, which almost certainly keeps him out of Sunday's 9:30 AM ET game vs JAX in London. The injury is not considered long term. He is RB9 rest of season for me. Monitor Friday's injury report; Will Shipley is the lead back if Barkley sits.

Will Shipley (PHI) played 28 of 61 snaps vs LAR and is the only other back on Philadelphia's active roster, with Tank Bigsby on IR and Barkley week to week. That makes him the lead back in London, not a backup. Claim him, 10 to 15 percent of FAAB.

Lamar Jackson (BAL) has a sprained left ankle and only an outside chance to play @ATL Sunday night, per NFL Network, and it could cost him more than one game. He left Week 4 vs TEN at halftime after going 15 of 20 for 222 and 2 TDs. QB2 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's practice report.

Tyler Huntley (BAL) gets his first start of the season @ATL if Jackson sits. He went 8 of 9 for 63 in relief Sunday, and Baltimore scored no points on his five drives. Superflex only: stash him, 6 to 10 percent of FAAB. One-QB leagues pass.

Pat Bryant (DEN) sprained his ankle @SF, a suspected high-ankle sprain, and is expected to miss a few weeks, per ESPN. He played 67 percent of the snaps the week before. WR62 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.
